one_line: Hold the object, state the worry in line one, then show each claim as an inserted picture.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 a woman in a bright living room, tight framing, holds a pacifier near her chest, eyes on the lens. Said (transcript): 'שימוש במוצץ יכול להשפיע על הדיבור ועל מראה הפנים של הילד שלכם'. Same line in a white box.
q1_hook.why: A warning about an item most parents of babies use, said at once by a person looking at the lens and holding the object (H1, H4, F6). It is both said and shown, in a headline box and word captions (H6, T3). The claim sounds medical and names no source (K4).

beats.what: Tight framing, pacifier in hand; headline box and word-by-word captions
beats.why: Warning and object in one frame, no intro.

beats.what: Framing pulls back; she says pacifiers have benefits and her own daughters use one (transcript)
beats.why: The balance and her own use make the warning less preachy.

beats.what: Anatomy drawing of a pacifier pressing the palate, then palate and teeth drawings; 'החך העליון', 'גבוה וצר'
Close photo of a child's mouth, then a toddler's face; 'המוצץ גורם ללשון להיות נמוכה וקדמית'
beats.why: Real faces add feeling to the explanation.

beats.what: Mouth-model animation, a finger on the palate, tongue up; 'למעלה בתקרת הפה', 'שתרווח'
beats.why: Shows where the tongue should rest.
The list of consequences lands on a face.
An open question just before the asks.

beats.what: Follow sticker; box 'עקבו אחרי לתכנים נוספים בנושא התפתחות שפה ודיבור'
'הכנתי לכם גם מדריך'; she points down; 'הגיבו מדריך בתגובות ואשלח לכם'
beats.why: Second ask: a guide for one word.

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: Comment word 'מדריך' for a language guide (0:59 to 1:01, said, boxed, and in the caption), a Follow sticker at 0:53, and 'wait for the next video'.
q2_flow.why: One static take with an inserted picture every 5 to 6 s gives movement without cuts, moving from drawing to real mouth to model (R3, E2). The question at 0:49 re-opens the gap, but its answer is held for another Reel (H5). At 61 s, the middle is long for one idea (R1, R2).

q3_cta.what: 0:53 Follow sticker and 'עקבו אחריי וחכו לסרטון הבא'; 0:59 to 1:01 'הגיבו מדריך בתגובות ואשלח לכם', spoken and in a box. Caption repeats the comment word and a follow ask.
q3_cta.why: The comment word delivers a real thing, a guide, and is said, shown and repeated in the caption after the value (C3, C6). But follow and comment are two asks, with the offer named last (C1). The guide is introduced only at about 0:55.

q4_shown.what: She holds a pacifier, a grey fuzzy item attached, all Reel. Inserts over her torso: an anatomy drawing 0:14 to 0:23, a child's mouth 0:24, a toddler's face 0:30, a mouth model 0:36 to 0:44, a baby photo 0:45. No product for sale, no price.
q4_shown.why: Authority comes from her role (named in the caption) and a picture for each claim (S6, R3). No study or source is named on screen, and some images look like stock (K4). The child photos show faces, which LumeBook's own Reels should avoid (S5).

q5_edit.what: One cut at 4 s (framing pulls back), then one static take. Seven inserted images over her torso every 4 to 9 s. Word-by-word subtitles at about 52% of the frame height. Ends mid-gesture on the CTA, no end card.
q5_edit.why: An insert every 5 to 6 s gives movement with no cuts (E2, R3), and word captions keep the eye moving (E4). But inserts and captions crowd the middle (T2). Most of the 61 s is explanation (R2). It stops on the ask (E8).

q6_topic.what: Why long pacifier use may affect the palate, tongue and speech, from a speech therapist. Serves parents of babies and toddlers who use pacifiers.
q6_topic.why: An item nearly every parent of a baby owns is tied to speech, which they care about (K6). The line 'my own daughters use one' softens the warning (K4). The claims are strong and the fix is withheld to the next Reel (K4).

q7_filmed.what: Phone on a tripod, static, eye level, in a bright living room with window light, a plant and shelves behind. She stands facing the lens, one hand holding the pacifier up. Tight framing at the start, then pulled back.
q7_filmed.why: Straight to the lens suits a person talking to 'you' (F6, H4). Window light and a plain room look homemade but clean (H8, F7). The pacifier is small and the grey fuzzy item distracts (F4). Inserts sit over her torso, partly in the bottom 35% (F2).

q8_text.on_screen: 0:00 to 0:04: a white three-line box, 'שימוש במוצץ יכול להשפיע על הדיבור ועל מראה הפנים של הילד שלכם', at about 57 to 70% of the frame height, plus large white bold word-by-word subtitles above it. Then subtitles only, 1 to 3 words ('החך', 'גבוה וצר'). End: Follow sticker (0:53) and boxes 'הגיבו מדריך בתגובות ואשלח לכם' (1:00).
q8_text.caption: 'שימוש במוצץ יכול להשפיע על הדיבור ועל מראה הפנים של הילד שלכם.' The hook repeated, a short explanation, a promise of a follow-up Reel, 'הגיבו מדריך בתגובות ואשלח לכם אותו', a credential line and a follow ask. About 100 words, no hashtags.
q8_text.why: A headline box and word captions make it work muted (T1, T3), but the box and the inserts sit in the lower middle over a busy picture (T4, F2, T2). The caption opens with the hook in searchable words and repeats the CTA with a clear benefit, but has no hashtags (T7, C6).

weak_points: 61 s for one idea; medical-sounding claims with no source; the how-to answer held for another Reel; a grey fuzzy item on the pacifier; inserts in the bottom band; two asks.
lumebook_takeaway: Hold the book up to a propped phone, state the parent's worry in the first line, and offer a free guide for one comment word. No child needed.
not_verified: What the fuzzy item on the pacifier is (it looks like a microphone cover). The source of the inserted images and the accuracy of the medical claims (not assessed). Music (none evident). Correction: the headline box sits in the lower middle of the frame, not the upper area. Lead edit 18 Oct: resolution remarks removed, because the downloaded copy can be smaller than what was posted.
